title: Climate Solutions Research Kit: open spatial-prior method and smelter-resolved CF4 (PFC-14) prior
description: Reusable method and worked case studies for building point-source-resolved spatial priors for orphaned high-GWP greenhouse gases, including the open smelter-resolved spatial prior for CF4 from primary-aluminium smelting and an HFC-134a refrigerant-bank negative result. This record archives a tagged release of the code repository; the gridded prior datasets are archived separately on Zenodo (CF4 concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20617485; HFC-134a concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20652491).
